words.gloss: things that are not virtuous (vices or evils)

literal: Virtue without-deviating, non-virtuous-things having-removed, valor unfailing, honor possessing-one, (is) the ruler.
translation: A true ruler is one who never deviates from virtue, eliminates all that is evil, and possesses unfailing valor and honor.
modern: அறநெறியிலிருந்து தவறாமல், தீமைகளை நீக்கி, வீரத்தில் குறையாத மானத்தைக் கொண்டிருப்பதே சிறந்த அரசாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the essential qualities of an ideal ruler or government. First, the ruler must steadfastly adhere to righteousness (அறன்) without slipping (இழுக்காது) and actively banish all forms of vice or injustice (அல்லவை நீக்கி). Second, the ruler must possess a sense of honor (மானம்) that never falters in courage or valor (மறன் இழுக்கா). By balancing moral integrity with strength and dignity, a ruler commands true authority.
